item.title: Change Of Venue For Clare’s National Camogie League Tie With Wexford
item.description: A change of venue has been announced for Clare’s National Camogie League game this afternoon. Due to an unplayable pitch in Clareabbey, The Banner’s Division 1B tie with Wexford has been relocated to Meelick. As a result throw in for that game has been pushed back to 2:30pm. item.title: Late Surge Sees Flannan’s Into Last 4 Of Croke Cup
item.description: St.Flannan’s have booked their spot in the semi final of the Croke Cup following a late second half surge. item.title: Clare Record First Win Of Camogie League With Impressive Victory Over Wexford
item.description: Clare have recorded their first win of their Camogie League Division 1B campaign. An impressive display saw Eugene Foudy’s side defeat fellow promotion hopefuls Wexford 0-15 to 0-9. The damage was done in the first half as Clare raced into an eight point lead which they never relinquished.
